name: Secure Gmail
description: Wraps the Gmail MCP server's tools with mcp-hooks ingress security (prompt-injection guard + secret redactor).

gmailMcpCommand.description: Path to the gmail-mcp Python interpreter (e.g. ~/git/puddles/servers/gmail-mcp/.venv/bin/python).

gmailMcpArgs.description: Args passed to gmailMcpCommand to launch the MCP server.

gmailMcpCwd.description: Working directory for the gmail-mcp subprocess (optional).

llmProvider.description: Node module specifier whose default export is a class implementing mcp-hooks' LLMClient interface (e.g. a workspace package name or absolute path). The plugin dynamic-imports this at startup and constructs it with `{ model, ...llmProviderOptions }`.

llmProviderOptions.description: Extra constructor options forwarded to the llmProvider class (merged with { model }).

model.description: Model id passed to the llmProvider class constructor. The provider decides what counts as a valid id.

skipTools.description: Tool names to register without ingress hooks.
